title: MaxPooling3D and AveragePooling3D functions crash or return infinite values when pool_size contains zero or negative values
trigger_payload:
import tensorflow as tf
pool_size = [2, 2, 0]
layer = tf.keras.layers.MaxPooling3D(strides=1, pool_size=pool_size)
input_tensor = tf.random.uniform([3, 4, 10, 11, 12], dtype=tf.float32)
res = layer(input_tensor)
oracle: crash with Floating point exception (core dumped) or output tensor with all inf values
